items_flat.title_en: OpenAI will end direct model access for SpaceX-owned Cursor on 12 Nov
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 擬於 11 月 12 日終止向 SpaceX 旗下 Cursor 直接供應模型
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI said it notified SpaceX it will wind down the contract that supplies OpenAI models to Cursor, proposing a 12 November 2026 shutoff—the maximum notice in the change-of-control clause. It will not provide future models, including Astra. The company cited past ToS and contract breaches by Musk-owned firms after X and xAI came under SpaceX.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 表示已通知 SpaceX，將依控制權變更條款給予最長預告期，擬於 2026 年 11 月 12 日終止向 Cursor 直接供應模型，且不提供含 Astra 在內的後續模型。理由是無法確信 SpaceX 會遵守服務條款，並援引 X 與 xAI 過往違約紀錄。
items_flat.analysis_en: The cutoff converts a multi-model IDE into a more vertically integrated SpaceX/xAI surface and tests whether change-of-control clauses become standard weapons after lab or platform M&A. Whether developers keep OpenAI via BYO keys, and whether the November date holds, remains unsettled.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此事把多模型編碼 IDE 推向更垂直整合的 SpaceX／xAI 生態，也測試控制權變更條款會否成為實驗室併購後的常規武器。開發者能否改以自備 API 金鑰續用、11 月日期會否再談，仍未定案。
items_flat.quote: Today, we notified SpaceX that we intend to wind down our contract providing OpenAI models to Cursor, with a proposed shutoff date of November 12, 2026.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們今日已通知 SpaceX，打算終止向 Cursor 提供 OpenAI 模型的合約，擬議關閉日期為 2026 年 11 月 12 日。

items_flat.title_en: Sony Music and Warner Chappell sue Anthropic over Claude training data
items_flat.title_zh: Sony Music 與 Warner Chappell 起訴 Anthropic 以歌曲訓練 Claude
items_flat.summary_en: Sony Music Publishing and Warner Chappell Music filed suit in the Northern District of California against Anthropic and co-founders Dario Amodei and Benjamin Mann, alleging torrenting, scraping and downloading of copyrighted compositions to train Claude. They seek up to $150,000 per work plus CMI-stripping damages. Anthropic said it disagrees and will defend itself in court.
items_flat.summary_zh: Sony Music Publishing 與 Warner Chappell 於加州北區法院起訴 Anthropic 及共同創辦人 Dario Amodei、Benjamin Mann，指控以 BT、爬取與下載受著作權保護的曲目訓練 Claude，並求每件最高 15 萬美元及移除著作權管理資訊之損害賠償。Anthropic 表示不同意指控，將積極應訴。
items_flat.analysis_en: Coming after Anthropic’s earlier author/publisher settlement, the case extends the training-data fight from books into major music catalogs and names founders personally. Statutory-maximum math can reach billions, but liability, fair-use scope and any settlement remain unproven.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此案接在 Anthropic 先前與作者／出版商和解之後，把訓練資料爭議從書籍擴到主流樂譜目錄，並點名創辦人個人。法定上限可堆到數十億美元量級，但侵權成立、合理使用範圍與是否和解皆未定。
items_flat.quote: We disagree with the publishers’ claims and we intend to defend ourselves robustly in court.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們不同意出版商的主張，並打算在法庭上強力為自己辯護。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic to replace Claude Code’s 50% weekly-limit promo with a 25% permanent raise on 14 Sep
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic：Claude Code 50% 週限額優惠至 9/14，之後改為永久提高基準 25%
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic’s developer account said that from 14 September it will permanently raise standard weekly Claude Code limits by 25% for Pro, Max, Team and seat-based Enterprise plans, and that the current 50% increase stays until then. A follow-up post stated that versus today’s promo cap this is a 17% reduction.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 開發者帳號宣布，自 9 月 14 日起將把 Claude Code 標準週限額永久提高 25%，適用 Pro、Max、Team 與座位制 Enterprise；在此之前維持現有 50% 加成。後續貼文承認，相較今日優惠額度，實際減少約 17%。
items_flat.analysis_en: The math matters more than the headline: heavy agent users who staffed work against the summer promo will lose capacity unless they buy usage credits. Anthropic flagged unspecified upcoming controls for visibility; those details are not yet public.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 數字比標題重要：依夏季優惠排產的重度代理用戶，若未加購用量額度，9 月後可用量會下降。公司預告將推出更清楚的用量可視與控制，細節尚未公布。
items_flat.quote: Starting September 14, we're permanently raising standard weekly limits in Claude Code by 25% for Pro, Max, Team, and seat-based Enterprise plans. Until then, the current 50% increase will be in place.
items_flat.quote_zh: 自 9 月 14 日起，我們將把 Claude Code 標準週限額永久提高 25%，適用 Pro、Max、Team 與座位制 Enterprise。在此之前，維持目前的 50% 提高。

items_flat.title_en: Official DALL·E GPT retires in ChatGPT; image gen moves to ChatGPT Images
items_flat.title_zh: ChatGPT 官方 DALL·E GPT 今日下架，改走 ChatGPT Images
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI’s ChatGPT release notes say the official DALL·E GPT is retired on 30 August 2026 and users should download images they want to keep. Image generation continues via ChatGPT Images; user-created GPTs with image generation enabled are not affected.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI ChatGPT 更新說明寫明，官方 DALL·E GPT 於 2026 年 8 月 30 日退役，建議先下載欲保留的圖片。圖像生成改由 ChatGPT Images 承接；已啟用圖像生成的使用者自建 GPT 不受影響。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a product-surface sunset, not an end to OpenAI image models. The practical uncertainty is what happens to unsaved DALL·E GPT outputs after today; OpenAI has not published a retention rule.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是產品入口下架，並非 OpenAI 停止圖像模型。未另存的 DALL·E GPT 產出今日之後如何處置，官方尚未公布保留規則。
items_flat.quote: On August 30, 2026, we’re retiring the official DALL·E GPT in ChatGPT. We encourage you to download any images you want to keep before then. To continue creating or editing images, use ChatGPT Images.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們將於 2026 年 8 月 30 日退役 ChatGPT 中的官方 DALL·E GPT。請在此之前下載想保留的圖片。之後請改用 ChatGPT Images 繼續生成或編輯圖像。
